usamts-1998-r1-01.prompt: Several pairs of positive integers $(m, n)$ satisfy the condition $19m + 90 + 8n = 1998$. Of these, $(100, 1)$ is the pair with the smallest value for $n$. Find the pair with the smallest value for $m$.

usamts-1998-r1-02.prompt: Determine the smallest rational number $\frac{r}{s}$ such that $\frac{1}{k} + \frac{1}{m} + \frac{1}{n} \le \frac{r}{s}$ whenever $k$, $m$, and $n$ are positive integers that satisfy the inequality $\frac{1}{k} + \frac{1}{m} + \frac{1}{n} < 1$.

usamts-1998-r1-03.prompt:
It is possible to arrange eight of the nine numbers
$$2,\ 3,\ 4,\ 7,\ 10,\ 11,\ 12,\ 13,\ 15$$
in the vacant squares of the 3 by 4 array shown below so that the arithmetic average of the numbers in each row and in each column is the same integer. Exhibit such an arrangement, and specify which one of the nine numbers must be left out when completing the array.

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline 1 & \phantom{00} & \phantom{00} & \phantom{00}\\\hline & 9 & & 5\\\hline & & 14 & \\\hline\end{array}$$
usamts-1998-r1-03.answer:
Leave out $10$; the array is
$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline 1 & 13 & 3 & 15\\\hline 11 & 9 & 7 & 5\\\hline 12 & 2 & 14 & 4\\\hline\end{array}$$
(every row and column has average 8).

usamts-1998-r1-04.prompt: Show that it is possible to arrange seven distinct points in the plane so that among any three of these seven points, two of the points are a unit distance apart. (Your solution should include a carefully prepared sketch of the seven points, along with all segments that are of unit length.)
usamts-1998-r1-04.answer: Use the *Moser spindle*: two rhombi, each made of two unit equilateral triangles, sharing one vertex and rotated so their far tips are 1 apart. Its 7 points split into the shared vertex plus two triangles, so no 3 points are pairwise non-adjacent.

usamts-1998-r1-05.prompt:

$$\frac{(x-19)^2}{19} + \frac{(y-98)^2}{98} = 1998.$$
Let $R_1$, $R_2$, $R_3$, and $R_4$ denote those areas within the ellipse that are in the first, second, third, and fourth quadrants, respectively. Determine the value of $R_1 - R_2 + R_3 - R_4$.
